ext_description.message: Solves image captchas with human-like input, rates measured on each site's own server. Use it only where you are authorized.

cmd_solve.message: Solve the captcha on this page

menu_mark_image.message: Browsa Solver: this picture is a captcha

menu_mark_input.message: Browsa Solver: the answer goes in this field

off_bar.message: The solver is off. Nothing is solved.

onboard.message: Solving needs a Browsa API key. A new account gets free solves to try it, with no card.

t_mode_auto.message: Solve as soon as a captcha shows

t_no_trusted_firefox.message: Needs real pointer input, which Firefox does not offer to add-ons

t_text_site.message: Solve picture-text captchas here without asking

typed_note.message: Typed into the field. The site checks it when you send the form.

t_wrong.message: Tell Browsa the site refused the last answer of this solve. Browsa decides about a refund.

st_unreachable.message: This page can't be reached by the extension

trial_daily_title.message: Up to $1 a day; $2 used today

key_refused.message: Your key was refused. Check it in the dashboard, or paste a new one.

key_trial_used.message: Your free solves are used up. Solving starts again when you buy credits.

key_no_credits.message: Out of credits. Solving starts again when you add some.

key_offline.message: Couldn't reach Browsa. Check your connection; nothing is charged meanwhile.

r_unsupported.message: This captcha type isn't supported yet

r_type_off_service.message: Browsa's service does not solve this type right now.

r_error_key_denied_access.message: Your key was refused. Check it in the dashboard.

r_trial_used.message: Your free solves are used up. Buy credits to keep solving.

r_trial_daily.message: Today's free solves are used. More tomorrow, or buy credits.

r_needs_credits.message: Solving needs credits in your workspace.

r_account_unverified.message: Verify your Browsa account first (the email we sent you).

r_account_suspended.message: Your Browsa account is suspended. Write to support@browsa.io.

r_site_blocked.message: Browsa does not solve captchas on this site.

r_error_budget_exceeded.message: Your workspace's monthly limit is reached

r_key_limit.message: Your key's solving limit is reached for now. Try again later.

r_rate_limit.message: Too many solves at once. Try again in a few seconds.

r_site_off.message: Solving is off on this site

r_site_not_listed.message: This site is not in your list of allowed sites

r_type_off.message: $1 solving is off (switch it on in the panel)

r_no_trusted.message: $1 needs real pointer input, which this browser does not offer

r_ask_site.message: Solve picture captchas on this site?

r_text_no.message: Picture captchas are not solved on this site. Press Solve to solve one.

r_page_limit.message: Paused after 3 solves on this page. Press Solve to go on.

r_site_limit.message: Paused after 10 solves on this site in an hour. Press Solve to go on.

r_cooldown.message: Waiting 30 s after your last answer. Press Solve to solve now.

r_unverified.message: This doesn't come from the captcha's own provider, so it isn't solved by itself. Press Solve to solve it.

r_geetest_network.message: GeeTest couldn't reach its server. Try again in a moment.

r_network_error.message: Couldn't reach Browsa. Check your connection.

r_service_down.message: Browsa's service is busy. Try again in a few seconds.

r_refused.message: Google refused this browser for now. Try again later.

r_audio_only.message: Only a sound puzzle was offered, which is not supported

r_other_puzzle.message: This puzzle type isn't supported yet

r_not_taken.message: $1 did not take the click. Trusted input (Options) can help.

r_refused_by_site.message: The site's check refused this browser for now

r_no_captcha.message: No captcha found on this page

r_closed.message: The puzzle was closed before it was solved

r_mark_image.message: Picture marked. Now right-click the field its answer goes in and choose "the answer goes in this field".

r_mark_input_first.message: First right-click the captcha picture and choose "this picture is a captcha".

r_mark_saved.message: Saved for this site. Picture captchas here are now solved by themselves (Options, Sites).

r_mark_failed.message: Couldn't mark that. Right-click the captcha picture itself, then its answer field.

r_error_report_too_late.message: Too late to report: Browsa takes a report for 15 minutes after the solve.

r_error_report_not_solved.message: Nothing to report: this was never charged.

r_error_report_limit.message: Browsa did not take this report: too many of your recent solves were reported.

r_error_taskid_invalid.message: This answer can no longer be reported.

o_types_hint.message: Solve: the type is solved at all. By itself: without a click, when the panel is on Auto; off means it waits for the Solve button.

cost_credits.message: Credits per answer; a puzzle can take several

o_unlisted_hint.message: These did not reach our bar (9 of 10 accepted by the site) or could not be measured, so they are off. You can try them.

o_fail_hint.message: Only puzzle and network failures are tried again, never a key, credit or site refusal. Each answer the service gives is charged, also in a try that then fails.

o_button_hint.message: Shown only while a captcha waits for a click: in Manual mode, or for a type that does not solve by itself.

o_mode_all.message: All sites, except the ones below

ph_hosts.message: one host per line, e.g. example.com

o_text_sites.message: Picture text solved without asking on

o_custom_hint.message: On a page: right-click the captcha picture, "this picture is a captcha", then right-click its field, "the answer goes in this field".

o_trusted_hint.message: Real pointer events through the browser's debugger, for sites that refuse page events. The browser shows a bar while it is on.

o_trusted_firefox.message: Firefox does not let add-ons send real pointer events, so Trusted input and Press & hold are not available here.

o_submit_text.message: Press Enter after typing picture text

server_needed.message: Needed: the address of the solving server

o_export_key.message: Include my API key in the file

o_backup_hint.message: A file with these settings, to move them to another browser. Your key stays out unless you tick the box.

o_exported_key.message: Exported with your key: keep the file private.

o_import_not_json.message: That file is not a settings file (not JSON).

o_import_not_settings.message: That file was not exported from Browsa Solver.

o_perm.message: What the extension may do, and why

perm_sites.message: Read and change pages on all sites

perm_sites_why.message: A captcha can be on any site, inside a frame from its provider. The extension looks for one, reads only its picture and acts only on it.

perm_storage_why.message: Keeps these settings, your key and the last 50 solves on this device.

perm_menus_why.message: The two "this picture is a captcha" entries.

perm_debugger.message: Debugger (asked only if you turn on Trusted input)

perm_debugger_why.message: Sends real pointer and key events. Nothing is read through it.
